description: At midnight, a red bed facing east (foot at 3 -60 0, head at 4 -60 0) with a still pig standing on its head. Looking down at the foot, a click puts the player to sleep in the head (the server's teleport and entity data: the sleeping pose and the bed, which lay the player an eighth above the bed's top): the bed screen opens and lets go of the keys, the pitch goes to 0, and the pig doesn't push the sleeper. W is pressed while in bed (the screen takes it). After 100 ticks the server wakes the player beside the bed: the screen closes and reads the held W, and the player walks at once. Asleep again, Leave Bed is clicked after 20 ticks (STOP_SLEEPING, sent outside a tick): the server wakes the player.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
